column7: KFZ-2026-005. admin_dsn host is project-admin input; go-sql-driver/mysql v1.10.1 sizes its column slice from the server-announced result set column count before reading any column packet, so a hostile or intercepted plaintext server made a 4-byte header cost 228 MiB (8-byte counts: makeslice panic), as the first packet of a reply or after an OK with SERVER_MORE_RESULTS_EXISTS (no multi-statement needed; the revoke processlist query reaches it). Fixed by netutil.MySQLGuardDialer in openMySQLConfig and rotation MySQLExecutor.conn; also refuses truncated heads the driver panics on. Driver-level property: internal/netutil TestMySQLGuardAgreesWithDriver. TLS connections not covered (upstream go-sql-driver/mysql#1866).
